t: For clerical assistance to the Vice President, $235,080.

fable.w: This is a bare appropriation of funds for clerical staff for the Vice President. There is no tempting reading: no outside party, consultation, hearing, rulemaking, or right to sue is involved, and all actors are inside the federal government.
fable.s: For clerical assistance to the Vice President, $235,080.
